description: Per-asset tick data policy (AFML Ch.2 walkthrough 2026-10-23, shared/data/tick_curation.py). tick_source=curated makes AssetLayout.tick_root point to assets/{ASSET}/curated/ticks (quality-filtered, roll-adjusted where roll_adjust is true). Same quote-tick bar type for every asset.

USOIL.roll_note: Dukascopy E_Light follows the WTI front month; monthly roll gaps detected from early-stop daily breaks (AFML s.2.4.3; Snippet 2.2 gaps applied multiplicatively so Snippet 2.3 returns are preserved; latest prices equal raw). Moneta live roll handling must be checked before any USOIL edge goes live.
